The '''Borkeen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Borkeen Belt]].
